comingLast.roast: the bar has one job now: keep him here until they hand it over
6 to play, 10 to find - the gallery (the bar) is invested
2 holes for a jailbreak - 3 points cuts the wire
current run rate 1.2 - the presentation script has him pencilled in
4 points buys freedom - Miller is pricing it higher by the minute
4 left, 5 needed, one bar holding its breath
on 17 with 5 to play - scratch the plan, just add points, any points
escape number: 3. holes remaining: 3. belief in the clubhouse: modest.
on 19 - his caddy (his mate with the beers) has gone quiet
needs 6 from 6 - his playing group has started the commentary
